scope: Fold0 INNER-only scalar calibration diagnostic; fixed CPU CNN; no neural training/OUTER/Test/GPU/SSH/submission
candidate_and_gate_authority: Parent's explicit fixed instruction; no candidate/gate changes after results
fit_objective: mean((a*p+b-y)^2) + 0.01*((a-1)^2+b^2); offset fixes a=1; exact convex box-quadratic minimization via interior/faces/corners
application: clip(a*p+b,0,1), same scalar mapping for every query; score/presence unchanged

crossfit.reference_index: lexicographically sorted five positive reference_group keys
assertions: no background_group shared between fit and heldout
positive heldout reference components absent from fit
each input row heldout exactly once
crossfit.negative_convention: All zero controls use i=0, grouped by background shard; this convention is fixed and asymmetric, not an additional physical reference source.
crossfit.purge_scope: Original dataset TRAIN/INNER source/time purge remains unchanged. This calibrator only separates recorded background_group; it does not assert new 24h or station/sensor independence.

admission.comparisons_relative_to: identity on exact same heldout rows
admission.candidate_selection: lowest crossed RMSE among admitted candidates; fixed candidate order breaks ties
admission.none_admitted: identity; no rerun, no gate relaxation, no alternative partitions
admission.final_fit: refit the selected nonidentity candidate exactly once on the full INNER; identity has no fit

limitations: Base CNN already used the full INNER labels for early stopping and preprocessing development; these are calibrator-crossfitted diagnostics, not independent neural OOF estimates.
Synthetic generator/source representativeness is unproven for the challenge Test; no LB estimate is made.
Only five positive reference components; 3000 windows are not 3000 independent sources.
Scalar calibration changes the final share independently of the saved cell mask; the original mask explains the original physical pooling, not a transformed scalar.
